Bước 1: Lấy danh sách từ YouTube Playlist bằng F12

const list = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('ytd-playlist-video-renderer')).map(el => ({ title: el.querySelector('#video-title')?.textContent?.trim() || '', duration: el.querySelector('ytd-thumbnail-overlay-time-status-renderer #text')?.textContent?.trim() || '', link: el.querySelector('#video-title')?.href || '' })).filter(v => v.title && v.link); copy(JSON.stringify(list)); alert('Đã copy ' + list.length + ' video!');
